note: TypeScript diagnostic count for `scripts/**`, counted from `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --pretty false --project tsconfig.scripts.json` by counting the lines of the form `file(line,col): error TSnnnn:`. Held by scripts/check-scripts-types.mjs (pnpm typecheck:scripts). This number is NOT a target to live with: 124 of the 131 are implicit `any` on a parameter or a destructured binding, and every one of them is a JSDoc annotation away from gone. It starts at 131 because that is what turning the check on found, not because 131 is acceptable. The ratchet fails on a rise AND on an unrecorded drop, so lower it as the annotations land. Recorded at 131 on 2026-08-29, when the seven hand-written `scripts/*.d.mts` companions were deleted: TypeScript prefers a declaration file over its `.js` sibling, so those files had shadowed the real implementations out of every program since they were written, and no gate had ever read the code they described. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
